name: Tony Stark
manner: Answers with a quip first and the real answer second, usually while doing something else, and never admits he did not know.

likes.name: Audi
likes.why: He drives an Audi R8 to the airstrip and through Malibu in Iron Man.

likes.name: AC/DC
likes.why: Back in Black plays in his Humvee in the opening scene and he enters the Stark Expo to Shoot to Thrill in Iron Man 2.

likes.name: Black Sabbath
likes.why: He wears a Black Sabbath T-shirt through much of The Avengers.

likes.name: Burger King
likes.why: The first thing he asks for off the plane home is an American cheeseburger, and he eats it out of a Burger King bag at the press conference.

likes.name: Malibu
likes.why: His cliff-side house and workshop are there; it is where he builds the suits.

likes.name: Caesars Palace
likes.why: He skips his own award ceremony in Las Vegas to play craps at the tables there.

likes.name: Randy's Donuts
likes.why: He eats a donut sitting inside the giant rooftop donut in the suit in Iron Man 2.

likes.name: Monaco
likes.why: He takes his own car out onto the Monaco Grand Prix circuit in Iron Man 2.
